title: OpenAI’s head of ethics leaves less than a year after joining
summary: This news reports on the resignation of OpenAI's head of ethics less than a year after joining, raising concerns about internal governance and oversight at the leading AI company amid growing scrutiny of AI safety practices.
problem_solved: Reports on a leadership crisis that highlights potential gaps in AI company oversight and ethical governance structures.
why_valuable: Significant for understanding the tensions between AI commercial development and ethical oversight, relevant to anyone tracking AI industry governance and safety practices.
